data.content_ref: inline:Skeptical intersection over bounded edge-deletion variants: define a derived operator where an argument is 'robustly IN' iff it is IN in the grounded extension of the original graph and in the grounded extension of every variant obtained by deleting a single attack edge from a bounded, problem-declared set of suspect edges. The robust set is a pure function of (graph, suspect set), computable in polynomial time (|suspect|+1 grounded runs). This strengthens skepticism at the commitment layer without touching Pass 1, and hands the defender a concrete target: exhibit the single-edge deletion that would flip a root to non-IN, or concede the root is fragile.
